name: get_job
description: Fetch a document-processing job (status, file metadata, agent event trace, and result if finished) from the DocIntel job store in DynamoDB.

name: list_jobs
description: List recent document-processing jobs, newest first.

name: update_job_status
description: Set the job status (UPLOADED|QUEUED|PROCESSING|COMPLETED|FAILED) and append a trace event describing who did what. Call this whenever a processing stage starts or finishes.

status.description: One of UPLOADED, QUEUED, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED

agent.description: Agent name, e.g. orchestrator, docx-agent, databricks-pdf-agent

name: append_job_event
description: Append a trace event to the job without changing its status (for fine-grained progress like 'OCR complete, 2 pages').

name: save_job_result
description: Persist the final structured result for a job (summary, keyPoints, entities, topics, sentiment, language, pageCount, wordCount, extractionMethod, model and any Databricks references) and mark it COMPLETED unless another status is given.

result_json.description: JSON object serialised as a string

name: extract_docx_text
description: Download the job's DOCX from S3 and extract its text (paragraphs, headings, tables), word count and estimated page count. Only valid for docType=docx.

name: get_download_url
description: Create a short-lived presigned HTTPS URL so an external system (e.g. the Databricks PDF agent) can download the job's document from S3.

name: get_document_content
description: Return one base64-encoded byte range of the job's document, for callers that cannot reach S3 (e.g. Databricks serverless, whose egress blocks S3) and so cannot use get_download_url. Call from offset 0, advance offset by chunkBytes, and stop when done is true; any document size works.

offset.description: Byte offset to start at. Default 0

length.description: Max bytes to return. Default and max 3145728 (3 MB)
